query:
SELECT e.inep, e.nome, e.status AS escola_status, e.data_conclusao AS escola_data_conclusao,
       os.id AS os_id, os.status AS os_status, os.data_conclusao AS os_data_conclusao,
       os.qtd_ap_instalado, os.observacao
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escola_id = e.id
WHERE e.inep IN ('29132967', '29757622')
ORDER BY e.inep, os.id;
